lines.text: the time was half past chunk upon the clock
the atmosphere was humid, heavy, locked
my breath has grown so weighted in the air
this summer heat is more than i can bear
it is hard to picture any greater loss
mother has vanished, sleeping once again
high above, the moon burns cold and bright
cutting through the darkness of the night
within the distance, nothing seems to move
no creature stirs, no rolling ball appears
i search the silent garden and the ground
yet still my purpose cannot quite be found
i am all alone here in the chasm of my mind
there are no balls that wander
all the humans sleep so sound
i do not care how it is delivered unto me
and set my troubled mind free
once i hold that most sacred ball
my life i dedicate to thee
end these long and sleepless nights
there can be no sense of loss
if that ball and i reunite
my dear doja companion does not share my fright
she sleeps in peace beside our mother tonight
her peaceful mind is untouched by my delusion
no fluff-covered treasure returning to me
i am all alone here in the chasm of my mind
there are no balls that wander
all the humans sleep so sound
i do not care how it is delivered unto me
and set my troubled mind free
once i hold that most sacred ball
my life i dedicate to thee
end these long and sleepless nights
there can be no sense of loss
if that ball and i reunite
